newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major considering London Underground selloff.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major considering London Underground selloff.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday he would look at the possibility of privatising London's underground railway system.
Major told his Conservative Party annual conference that the sale of the separate British Rail network to the private sector was going well and would mean more and better services.

"I will look to see whether we can apply those principles to London Underground," Major told a conference delegate who had called during a question and answer session for London Underground and the Royal Mail to be sold off.
"I share many of your instincts," he added.
